noncomputable def VTask.comk {α : Type u_1} (p : Set α → Prop) (he : p ∅) (hmono : ∀ (t : Set α), p t → ∀ s ⊆ t, p s) (hunion : ∀ (s : Set α), p s → ∀ (t : Set α), p t → p (s ∪ t)) : Filter α :=
{
  mem := fun s => p sᶜ,
  zero_mem' := by simp [mem],
  one_mem' := by simp [mem, he],
  add_mem_left' := fun s t hs ht => by simp [mem, hunion hs ht],
  add_mem_right' := fun s t hs ht => by simp [mem, hunion ht hs],
  mul_mem' := fun s t hs ht => by simp [mem, hmono _ hs (by simp [subset_univ])],
}
